verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at cactuscompute.com (HTTP 200). It links agent-oriented docs pages under /llms/ (api, pricing, run-locally), and those docs say the platform can be run from "a coding agent with your API key". The docs also address the agent directly, e.g. "Check it before you submit anything that spends allowance". Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://cactuscompute.com/llms.txt # Cactus Compute
The dashboard, CLI, Python, or a coding agent with your API key.
GET /billing returns your plan, its limits and what this period has used. Check it before you submit anything that spends allowance.
What you can do with no key: read these docs, GET https://cactuscompute.com/v1/plans for hosted fine-tuning prices, and download the base model
